disagreements.positions: All five treat a Nutrition spin by end-2027 as announced; agents 1/4 deduct separation cash (-$320M/-$400M), agent_3 puts $350M in FY27 other_uses, agents 2/5 nothing; ladder branches 10-12%.
disagreements.resolution: Confirmed at the primary source: Abbott 8-K (CIK 1800, accession 0001104659-26-117587, filed 2026-10-21) Ex. 99.1 announces the intention to separate Nutrition (~$8.5B sales) via a tax-free distribution, expected by end-2027, one-time charges to be quantified; CFO on the call: costs are specified items excluded from adjusted EPS. Quote ~$9 lower if distributed before the horizon: the mean of agent_1's ($1.65B EBITDA x 14x - $4.5B debt) / 1,729M = $10.7 and agent_5's (($1,540M - $150M) x 12x - $4B) / 1,725M = $7.35 derivations, low confidence.
